audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is nonce incremented before message execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL transaction processing (nonce increment, process_transaction, process_message_call) is not implemented in Prysm, which is a consensus layer (CL) client. This logic resides in execution layer clients (Geth, Reth, Nethermind, etc.).

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are gas fees deducted from sender balance before message execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas fee deduction (effective_gas_fee, blob_gas_fee deduction before process_message_call) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Is unused gas refunded at the correct effective_gas_price?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas refund calculation (gas_left * effective_gas_price) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Does coinbase receive only the priority fee portion (not base fee)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL coinbase payment and EIP-1559 fee distribution (priority fee vs base fee burn) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are accounts marked for deletion destroyed after transaction execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL SELFDESTRUCT account deletion (accounts_to_delete processing) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Does beacon roots system transaction execute before user transactions?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL system transaction ordering (BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS, apply_body, process_unchecked_system_transaction) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EIP-4788 beacon roots contract execution is handled by EL clients.

audit_items.title: Does history storage system transaction execute as second operation?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL system transaction ordering (HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS, apply_body) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are transactions processed in sequential order within a block?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL transaction ordering within apply_body is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). Transaction sequencing and execution is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are withdrawals processed after all transactions?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL-level withdrawal ordering within apply_body (process_withdrawals after transactions) is not implemented in Prysm. While Prysm has CL ProcessWithdrawals (beacon-chain/core/blocks/withdrawals.go) for beacon state, the EL ordering concern is about EL block execution which resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are general purpose requests processed last in block body?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL-level request ordering within apply_body (process_general_purpose_requests after withdrawals and transactions) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are request types appended in correct order (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL-level request type ordering (process_general_purpose_requests assembling deposits, withdrawals, consolidations) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are deposit requests parsed from block output logs (not system transactions)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL-level deposit request parsing from log entries (parse_deposit_requests) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This log-based deposit parsing is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are withdrawal and consolidation requests from checked system transactions?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL-level system transaction handling (process_checked_system_transaction for withdrawal/consolidation request contracts) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). This logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are blocks with number < 1 rejected?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block header validation (validate_header rejecting block number < 1) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL header validation is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are block timestamps strictly increasing?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block header timestamp validation (validate_header checking timestamp > parent.timestamp) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL header validation is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Are block numbers sequential (parent.number + 1)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block header number sequencing validation (validate_header checking number == parent.number + 1) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL header validation is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Does parent_hash cryptographically match parent header?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block header parent_hash validation (keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header))) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL header validation is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Does excess_blob_gas match calculation from parent?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL excess_blob_gas calculation and validation is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). Prysm only stores ExcessBlobGas as a protobuf field in execution payloads received from EL via Engine API. The actual calculation/validation resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Is gas_used <= gas_limit enforced in header?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block header gas_used <= gas_limit validation is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL header validation is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Do system transactions originate from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff...fe)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL system transaction origin address (SYSTEM_ADDRESS) handling is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). System transaction construction and execution resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does base fee calculation enforce minimum increase of 1 when gas exceeds target?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL base fee calculation (calculate_base_fee_per_gas) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). Prysm only stores BaseFeePerGas as a field in execution payload protobuf definitions. The actual calculation resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Verify transaction validation check ordering: Are checks ordered from general to specific?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL transaction validation ordering (transaction_validation_dispatch) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). Transaction validation logic resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is extra_data in block header limited to 32 bytes?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block header extra_data size validation (validate_header, 32 byte limit) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL header validation is handled by execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is gas limit change bounded by parent_gas_limit // 1024?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas limit change validation (check_gas_limit, parent_gas_limit // 1024 bound) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL gas limit validation resides in execution layer clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is gas limit >= 5000 (GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM) enforced?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas limit minimum validation (check_gas_limit, GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM = 5000) is not implemented in Prysm (CL client). EL gas limit validation resides in execution layer clients.
